name: Replication failure details
description: Latest reported replication state per selected reporter/destination/site/naming context, including last failure. This complements the zero-filled error trend. Invalid failure counts remain unknown instead of becoming zero.
kql:
DCReplicationData_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, DestDSA, DestDSASite, NC
| extend Failures = tolong(NumberOfFailures), FailureTime = todatetime(LastFailureTime)
| project Computer, DestDSA, DestDSASite, NC, NumberOfFailures = Failures, LastFailureTime = FailureTime, LastObservation = TimeGenerated
| order by NumberOfFailures desc, Computer asc
